name: Lance
description: Lance is a lightweight, 3B-active-parameter native unified multimodal model developed by ByteDance. It handles image and video understanding, generation, and editing within a single dual-stream Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture trained via multi-task synergy.
keyFeatures: Native Unified Multimodal Framework: Single model for image/video understanding, generation, and cross-modal editing
Dual-Stream Mixture-of-Experts (MoE): Decouples high-level semantic reasoning pathways from visual generative synthesis with 3B active parameters
Modality-Aware Rotary Positional Encoding (MaPE): Manages heterogeneous semantic and 3D causal VAE latent tokens without cross-modal positional interference
Staged Multi-Task Training Recipe: Multi-stage training (CT1-CT3) balancing performance across diverse understanding and generation tasks
Efficient Hardware Budget: Trained from scratch using under 128 GPUs, operating at ~20% compute cost of traditional dense unified models
curatorNotes: Verified academic research paper and open-source model from ByteDance. Paper published on arXiv (2605.18678), codebase released under Apache-2.0 license on GitHub, and model weights hosted on Hugging Face.
